build_EVL_model: build a python module to instantiate an EVL model with 2D and 3D video backbones for 3D object detection
run_EVL_forward: run the EVL forward pass on a batch to predict 3D oriented bounding boxes and occupancy
run_EVL_post_process: run the EVL post_process method to apply NMS and transform OBB predictions to snippet coordinates
review_EVL_init: review the EVL class __init__ to understand how 2D backbones, 3D lifters, and CNN heads are wired together
summarize_EVL_forward: summarize the EVL forward method that extracts 2D features, lifts to 3D voxels, and runs detection heads
